svg.text: 10 · The venue screen: standings, bracket, check-in, match called, champion (attendees in the hall)
Use case: the hall follows the session from the screens; Screen draws the widgets (built), Moments decides the peaks (built)
The Pulse during the session: bracket hero, standings, check-in QR

g.text: until 19:25 · scan with your phone, or tap the push

g.text: Go to Stage 2 now · Voice: Alpha room, Gamma room

svg.text: bracket and leaderboard are Screen's widgets (built templates); step 7 feeds them (P5).
Rank changes slide with ▲▼ for 60 s; finalists are framed (widgets.md, accepted design).
checkin_qr with purpose tournament:<session> while check-in is open (screen.md) (D6).
Match called fills voice_channels from the bot's room names; today it is always empty (D8).
One happening, one owner: the standings rule or the crew's spotlight, never both (step 4).
Champion: Moments' preset 4 on the final's match.finished; names only with consent (L7).
